notes: Kudos (KUDO) on Sepolia. LaunchToken (src/LaunchToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments, 18 decimals and no mint/admin functions; it mints exactly 1,000,000,000 KUDO to msg.sender (the factory). KudosEpochs (src/KudosEpochs.sol) takes the launch token address as its only constructor argument (address token_ <- $token), stores it immutable as token() and records deployTimestamp; it needs no KUDO balance or approval at deploy. It has no owner, admin, pause or upgrade path, no payable/receive/fallback function, and no initialization calls. Each address may give 5 non-transferable kudos per 7-day epoch counted from deployment, with optional KUDO tips pulled via approve + safeTransferFrom and credited to the recipient's withdrawable balance; withdraw() is pull-based and nonReentrant. The pool pairs KUDO with native Sepolia ETH (zero address), fee 3000, tickSpacing 60, no hook; initialPrice is the 1:1 sqrtPriceX96 used only by legacy policies, as the pinned policy derives the opening price. Supply, allocations and ownership come from launch policy, not this manifest.
